wound.name: Wound
wound.effect: Bypasses Target Flow entirely. If Flow is already 0, this attack gets +Hit%.

possess.name: Possess
possess.effect: Target is possessed for the next Sequence.

empower.name: Empower
empower.effect: The Target Character receives +1 Control and +1 AP until the Crafter either cancels the effect or has insufficient AP to maintain the effect.

resonance.name: Resonance
resonance.effect: Whenever a Lava or Lightning Spell is cast, immediately regain 1 Focus Point

current.name: Current
current.effect: The Target has their Life and Lightning Stats change from N to 0, or 0 to 1. First ignition needs Range 1 (face to face); once a Shadow Possession Link exists, Range no longer applies.

influence.name: Influence
influence.effect: The Target Character has their Relationship to some Information change (Crafter picks a Glyph and an Axis, adjusting the Axis by +1 or -1).

heartAttack.name: Heart Attack
heartAttack.effect: Target's Flow is reduced to 0. If Flow is already 0, a chance to deal 1 Wound at 50% Hit%.

skullExplosion.name: Skull Explosion
skullExplosion.effect: An attack is made with 10 Power against the Target.

separation.name: Separation
separation.effect: First Era: converts a Molten Lava Tile immediately to the right of the user into Inert Stone. (Third Era: any Tile becomes a Map Obstacle instead — not built yet.)

infuse.name: Infuse
infuse.effect: Converts a Molten Lava Tile immediately to the right of the user into a Molten One (active possession).

bloodkindle.name: Bloodkindle
bloodkindle.effect: Target gains +10 Power on all attacks made during the Sequence.

message.name: Message
message.effect: Sets an Expression in another Character's Mindeye.
